bundleDigest: <FILL: 0x sha256 of the canonical tar of the purchased payload WITHOUT manifest.json>
imageDigest: <FILL: 0x sha256 image id of the runner image built from Dockerfile.runner (see IMAGE_DIGEST)>

image.archive: <FILL: sha256 of `docker save` archive shipped with the bundle, or null if referenced by digest>

taskMaskOrder: bit i of an on-chain taskMask refers to taskIds[i]

entrypoints.output: exactly one JSON object per line on stdout

observation.reset.title: string
observation.reset.statement: string (issue-style bug report with a short repro)

action.jsonSchema.description: Machine-readable form of `action`: one JSON Schema per action, discriminated by `type`. A harness generates one tool per branch (tool name = the `type` const, arguments = the other properties). x-terminal marks the action that ends the episode; x-countsAgainstBudget says whether it uses one of resources.actionBudget.

oneOf.title: list_files
oneOf.description: List files in the workspace, or in one subdirectory of it.

oneOf.title: read_file
oneOf.description: Read one workspace file (the first 64 KiB).

oneOf.title: write_file
oneOf.description: Replace the full content of an editable workspace file (buildkit/*.py) with the complete new file text (at most 256 KiB UTF-8).

path.description: workspace-relative path matching an editable pattern

oneOf.title: run_visible_tests
oneOf.description: Run the visible test suite and return the tail of its output.

oneOf.title: submit
oneOf.description: Submit the workspace for hidden-test grading.

gradeResult.diagnostics: object (private; never shown to the agent or published)

grader.successRule: all hidden tests pass AND termination == submitted
grader.method: rebuild starting state (src/ + overlay) in a fresh temp dir, copy only editable files from the workspace, add hidden tests, run pytest in a subprocess with a timeout, parse JUnit XML

resources.actionBudgetNote: submit does not count; after 12 tool actions only submit is accepted
resources.concurrency: episodes are independent; one workdir per episode, safe to run in parallel

determinism.seedPolicy: seed is recorded in episode state and grade diagnostics but does not alter task content
determinism.clocks: no module or test reads the clock (cron.next_run takes now as an argument); wall-clock time only affects the episode time budget
determinism.supportedRuntime: CPython 3.12 in the runner image (verified on linux/arm64 under Docker) and natively (verified on macOS arm64, CPython 3.12.14)

referenceProtocol.taskSelection: all purchased tasks, one episode each; audit tasks reported separately

license.summary: Seller-authored. Non-exclusive license for internal training and evaluation; redistribution of tasks, tests or solutions requires separate written permission (LICENSE-ENV.md).

provenance.summary: seller-authored for this listing on 2026-09-11; no upstream dataset or project code; third-party components are pytest and its dependencies only

conflicts.notes: none declared; audit tasks are seller-supplied, not independently curated
